facts.fact: Mozambique and Angola signed a memorandum of understanding on cooperation in communications, ICT, information and meteorology (technical and institutional cooperation, exchange of expertise, best practices for digital transformation), and a second on the space sector, on Monday 22 June 2026 in Maputo; the article is dated 2026-06-23.
facts.system: Angola-Mozambique MoU on communications and ICT

note: Earth station testing with ANGOSAT-2 is under way, not reported as the agreement started in the country, so no effect fact.
